title: BillingCreditSettledPayload
description: billing.credit.settled v1 (OpenVibe.Billing server/ops/credits.js settleHold(); written with the settlement row in the settle transaction): a Credits hold was settled once. It is AGGREGATE-ONLY on purpose: it carries no subject, no project_id and no account id, so a consumer can count services, routes and money but cannot reconstruct a person's statement; per-person statements are read from Billing's own ledger. OpenVibe.Report consumes it for aggregate analytics. Money is integer nano-USD as decimal strings (D1: never a float). Envelope: subject { type: credit-settlement, id: stl_… }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:billing.

settlement_id.description: ULID settlement id, the same one the settle result and Billing's statement use.

service.description: The hold's service (D9): which metered service spent the credit, e.g. ai. Read from the hold; the settle request does not carry it.

settled_at.description: When the settlement committed (the settlement row's created_at).

deployment_id.description: The answering attempt's deployment id, '<provider>:<model>' as sent in the settle request's attempts[].deployment_id; null when no attempt answered (a cache hit or a BYOK call with no managed attempt).

provider_access.description: The answering attempt's commercial route (D3); null when no attempt answered or its route did not state one.

rate_version.description: The retail rate-card version the usage was priced against (the settle request's retail.version).

usage.description: The measured token counts, the same shape as billing.credit-hold-settle-request@1's usage.

charge_nano_usd.description: The charge the settlement recorded, integer nano-USD (D1). Usage beyond the hold and free balance is separately shortfall_nano_usd.

supply_cost_nano_usd.description: What the route cost OpenVibe at supply, integer nano-USD (D1); 0 for BYOK.

shortfall_nano_usd.description: Usage beyond the hold and the free balance: owed, not collected (nano-USD, D1).

released_nano_usd.description: Hold amount returned to the account, integer nano-USD (D1).

byok.description: True when the caller supplied their own provider key; the retail charge is 0.

sandbox.description: True when the hold was funded from usd_credit_sandbox (BILLING_CREDITS_SANDBOX), never paid credit.
